claims: The Atlanta Hawks traded Trae Young to the Washington Wizards in January 2026
Trae Young is a four-time All-Star guard
The trade ended Trae Young's seven-plus season tenure as the face of the Atlanta Hawks franchise
The Atlanta Hawks received Corey Kispert and CJ McCollum in exchange for Trae Young
Trae Young's career averages with the Atlanta Hawks are 25.2 points and 9.8 assists
Trae Young remained a target of chants from New York Knicks fans during the 2026 playoffs
